sections.Profile:
Bonanza, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1964, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine inspired by the popular television Western series of the same name. This game marks Ed Krynski's debut as Gottlieb's lead designer

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Western, Licensed, TV Show
